purpose: Teach: 役職/折衝/統括/取り寄せ/開演/切り上げ/一段落/振り回さ

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新役職、若手にも、機会、与えよう。
lines.en: We should give the younger staff new roles too — let them grow into them.
lines.style: Measured, forward-thinking. Warm authority without weight. Eyes steady. Slight pause before the second clause — thoughtful, not hesitant.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。仕入先と折衝、定期的に行います。
lines.en: Understood. I'll keep regular contact with the vendors, work through any issues as they come up.
lines.style: Steady and present. No performance — just confirmation that he's heard and will follow through. Slight nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 統括チーム、規模、拡大するね。
lines.en: And we'll need to expand the coordinating team's capacity.
lines.style: Direct statement of fact. Light emphasis on 'expand' — not a question, a given. Calm and assured.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。特注品、取り寄せ依頼、しました。
lines.en: Got it. I've already placed the order for the custom pieces.
lines.style: Quick, efficient. Small pride in already having done it. Clipped at the end — no need to elaborate.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: イベント、開演直前、準備、整える。
lines.en: Everything needs to be ready right before the event kicks off.
lines.style: Quiet urgency. Light, matter-of-fact tone. The words matter but the delivery doesn't dramatise — this is just what needs to happen.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。会議、早めに切り上げますね。
lines.en: Absolutely. I'll wrap up the meeting early to free up the afternoon.
lines.style: Quick, responsive agreement. No friction — just moving to the next task. Efficient, not rushed.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: プロジェクト、一段落、皆で打ち上げ。
lines.en: Once we hit the finish line on this project, let's all go celebrate together.
lines.style: Warmth breaks through — genuine pleasure at the thought. Lighter pace, slight lift at the end. The kind of leader people want to work for.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。スケジュール、振り回されないように、調整します。
lines.en: Of course. I'll make sure the schedule stays flexible and doesn't run us ragged.
lines.style: Caring undertone. Steady reassurance. Not just agreeing — he's thinking ahead about what this will cost people and protecting for it.
